pin.label: Your PIN code
hero.title: The taste of home, wherever
hero.sub: Traditional vegetarian foods from every corner of India, made by regional makers. We deliver only where we can do it safely, and we tell you plainly when we can’t.
hero.note: Pilot opening soon. Join the waitlist and we’ll tell you the day your PIN code is covered.
journey.title:
One India.
Many traditions.
journey.lede: Follow one route across the map. Recipes change from district to district, so we list a dish under every region it is traditionally associated with.
journey.hint: Keep scrolling to follow the route.
journey.hintDone: Your turn. Tap any state to explore.
journey.hintStatic: Tap any state to explore. The gold tiles are on today’s route.
rail.title: Explore by state
rail.lede: Every state starts with five traditional vegetarian foods in our Library, and Bihar with seven. Makers and products join state by state as the pilot grows.
fest.title: Festival foods, before the festival
fest.lede: Chhath, Diwali and Durga Puja are when home feels furthest. Each collection will publish its order-by date up front, so what you order can arrive in time.
makers.title: Every product will name its maker and where it’s made
makers.lede: Maker profiles, photographs and stories go live with the pilot, only for makers we have verified. Until then, this is who we’re looking for.
how.title: From a craving to your door
notify.title: Missing a taste from home? Tell us.
notify.lede: Name the food and your PIN code. What people ask for most decides which makers we invite next, and we’ll message you when it can reach you.
footer.tag: The taste of home, wherever you are.
